idea-plugin.name: FlatBars
idea-plugin.description:
Syntax support for FlatBars templates (and the Handlebars / Mustache surfaces it covers), implementing the two-layer model of ADR-017:
  • A TextMate grammar (the floor) colours the default-delimiter forms everywhere — including Community IDEs and before the server attaches.
  • flatbars-lsp semantic tokens (the ceiling), on IntelliJ Ultimate (2023.2+), run the actual engine lexer and override the grammar, correcting the stateful regions (set delimiters, dialects, MaxBars operators) a grammar cannot track. The engine always wins where it runs. (Built with -PwithLsp.)
